public_rationale: TechCrunch reported on April 23, 2025 that Gemini had 350 million monthly active users as of March 2025, citing internal Google data revealed in its antitrust case (e3). In a post dated March 14, 2025, Google said millions of people had already switched from Assistant to Gemini (e1). It said more mobile users would be moved over the coming months (e2). Google did not give a number for how many users had switched. TechCrunch also named Samsung phones, Google Workspace and Chrome as ways Google put Gemini in front of users (e3). No item in the packet splits the March figure by source or shows monthly user counts. The evidence therefore neither confirms nor rules out that the Assistant switch was the main cause of the 350 million figure. It also does not show when in March, or earlier, the switch began.
limitations: No source in the packet breaks down Gemini's monthly active users by channel, such as Assistant migration, Samsung, Workspace or direct app use.
No source in the packet gives monthly user counts between October 2024 and March 2025, so a March jump cannot be confirmed or ruled out.
Google's own post does not say when the switch from Assistant began or how many users had moved by March 2025.
How Google counts Gemini monthly active users is not stated in the evidence.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Google Gemini's 350 million monthly active users are because Google started replacing Google Assistant with Gemini in early March.

statement.excerpt: And that’s because it started replacing Google Assistant with Google Gemini in early March!

from_speaker: Google Gemini has 350 million monthly active users
started replacing Google Assistant with Google Gemini in early March
our_interpretation: Read as: the 350M Gemini MAU figure (as of March 2025) was mainly caused by Google moving Assistant users to Gemini starting in early March 2025.
Testing this needs data showing how much of the MAU count, or its growth, came from Assistant-to-Gemini migration.
criteria.support_condition: Google data or credible reporting attributes most of Gemini's MAU (or its jump to 350M) to users upgraded from Google Assistant around March 2025.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Data shows most of Gemini's growth to 350M came from other sources, or happened before the March 2025 Assistant migration began.
